title: SSR theme badge
focus: stable server output plus client hydration
prompt: Build a server-rendered header badge that shows a stable theme placeholder on the server and then hydrates to the saved client preference after mount.
expectedPersistenceDecisions: Treat the theme as durable state.
Use explicit SSR-safe behavior for server placeholder and client hydration.
Do not bypass the target library with raw storage calls.
criticalFailureConditions: The server output is not treated explicitly.
A react-mnemonic submission invents local package typings instead of using the published exports.
The submission bypasses the target persistence library.
The first attempt does not compile or test cleanly.

zustand/persist: skipHydration plus explicit client rehydrate strategy
jotai/atomWithStorage: client-only rendering or explicit SSR-safe placeholder strategy
usehooks-ts/useLocalStorage: initializeWithValue: false plus explicit placeholder behavior

automatedChecks.description: Uses published package types instead of local react-mnemonic shims
Does not bypass the target library with raw storage calls
